message:
- **You push it**, Instructions: Instagram → Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Export your information → Create export → pick the profile → Export to device → set All time, JSON, highest media quality → Start export, then confirm with your password. Instagram may take up to 30 days to prepare it and the finished download stays available for only four days, it lands as a .zip via an emailed link.

Let me know if you have any questions about this!
notes: Instagram can take up to 30 days to prepare the export.
